title: Protecting Intellectual Properties in Children's Media
speaker: Barrister Lillian Okoye
speakerRole: Head of Legal & IP Directorate, Kiddies Media Ministries
desc: The definitive institutional training masterclass for all children's media producers, writers, animators, and contributing ministries. Master the statutory legal protocols for establishing perpetual chain of title, executing work-for-hire assignment covenants, safeguarding minor voice performers through executed parental consent deeds, and filing transparent AI-use disclosures.
points: Statutory Chain of Title: Executing unconditional Work-for-Hire agreements and vesting perpetual copyright in Kiddies Media Ministries.
Minor Contributor Safeguarding: Executing parental consent deeds and voice likeness releases before recording commences.
AI-Use Transparency & Disclosure: Documenting AI tools employed, prompt logs, and certified human creative oversight ratios.
Character & Brand Trademark Defense: Protecting silhouettes, character voices, and titles against external dilution.
citations: KMM Sovereign IP Charter Art. IV & VI

title: Statutory Broadcast Standards & Pre-Release Clearances
speaker: Deacon Tunde Adebayo
desc: Pre-flight screening protocols for all episode cuts prior to master delivery. Learn how directors and editorial leads audit video masters, EBU R128 audio loudness, and strobe thresholds before satellite playout.
points: Epilepsy protection standards: Maximum 3 flashes per second on screen (ITU-R BT.1702).
Audio loudness balancing: Normalization strictly to -24 LKFS broadcast threshold.
Color gamut limits to ensure visual safety on high-luminance HDR displays.
Lip-sync tolerances: Maximum 1 frame ahead or 2 frames behind dialogue audio.

title: Scriptural Fidelity & Biblical Accuracy in Kids Storytelling
speaker: Pastor Victor Chidi
desc: Preserving theological integrity while adapting biblical narratives into dynamic animated stories that anchor young hearts in the Word without distortion or fear.
points: Ensuring scripture passages are quoted and referenced with literal fidelity.
Age-appropriate portrayal of miracles, faith declarations, and victorious prayer.
Rigorous editorial clearance loop between writers room and the pastoral review council.
Prohibition of theological caricatures or fear-inducing behavioral tropes.

title: Global Merchandising, Toy Safety & Territorial Covenants
speaker: Sarah Jenkins, Esq.
desc: Legal parameters for physical Lovetoons plushies, coloring books, apparel, and non-hazardous toy manufacturing covenants for overseas export.
points: Mandatory EN-71 and ASTM F963 non-toxic certifications for all physical merchandise.
Strict exclusivity and territory definitions in overseas franchise deals.
Proper packaging trademark notices: Registered (R) and Copyright (C) placement.
Child choke hazard warning labels and age-grading verification audits.

title: Child Voice Actor Safeguards & Talent Welfare Guidelines
speaker: Barrister Lillian Okoye
desc: Studio recording regulations, maximum work windows, mandatory certified chaperone attendance, and psychological comfort protocols for young voice talents.
points: Maximum continuous recording session of 90 minutes with mandatory rest pauses.
Parental or certified legal chaperone presence required inside studio control rooms.
Guaranteed privacy covenants prohibiting release of minors personal details.
Ergonomic studio adjustments (height-adjustable mic arms, acoustic comfort).
